policy: audited-only; official normative claims and program facts remain separate
reviewer_role: independent semantic reviewer required before final authorization

CBC-001.claim: CBC encryption feeds ENC with the XOR of the current plaintext block and the preceding ciphertext (or IV for the first block).

program_fact.required_observation: the candidate data flow shows the value passed to ENC and its plaintext/previous-ciphertext-or-IV operands

CTR-001.claim: LEA CTR encryption and decryption both use the block-cipher encryption transform on the counter block.

program_fact.required_observation: the candidate resolves the invoked block-cipher transform and whether the path is CTR encryption or decryption

CTR-002.claim: Counter blocks used under the same secret key must not repeat across encrypted plaintext blocks or invocations.

program_fact.required_observation: the candidate establishes the counter initialization and reuse domain for the same key, not merely a local counter literal

LEA-001.claim: The LEA block size is 128 bits (16 bytes).

program_fact.required_observation: the candidate establishes the operative block size and its unit
the candidate establishes all accepted key lengths and their units

LEA-011.claim: The LEA key schedule uses the complete audited delta-constant set for the applicable key-size variants.

program_fact.required_observation: the complete constant table and applicable key-size variants are visible

LEA-021.claim: Each LEA-128 round key orders words as T0,T1,T2,T1,T3,T1.

program_fact.required_observation: the six-word round-key assignment and LEA-128 variant are resolved

LEA-023.claim: LEA decryption consumes encryption round keys in reverse round order.

program_fact.required_observation: the candidate data flow resolves decryption round-key order
